topography.project_purpose: CLever is a yield optimization protocol that automates the compounding and management of Curve and Convex liquidity positions. It offers leveraged yield strategies and liquid locker tokens to maximize returns for liquidity providers.
topography.relationship_narrative: The CLever family consists of a single product line where the Vault contract interacts with multiple Vyper contracts to execute yield strategies. All contracts share the same deployer cluster, indicating a unified infrastructure.
